changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r JOIN resources res ON res.code = 'PROJECTS' WHERE r.code = 'BUYER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.resource_id = res.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM roles r JOIN resources res ON res.code = 'PROJECTS' JOIN role_resources rr ON rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code = 'READ' WHERE r.code = 'BUYER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = rr.id AND x.operation_id = o.id );
